newsitem.title: USA: Texaco arm creating product pipeline system.
newsitem.headline: Texaco arm creating product pipeline system.

text.p: Texaco Trading and Transportation Inc is creating a 1,300 mile pipeline system to transport gasoline, diesel and jet fuels from the Texas Gulf Coast to terminals at numerous destinations in northern and western Texas, Oklahoma and Kansas, Texaco Inc said Friday.
When complete, the system will have a combined capacity of more than 200,000 barrels per day, the company said.

Although Texaco Trading declined to discuss terms of the various transactions planned to create the new system, Vice President for Business Development Dan Nerbonne said it would have a total value "over $200 million."
